title: STARTEX — Social Engineering Olympics

fields.staffing: Full shifts in Operations, Maintenance and IT
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:00 AM on a busy Thursday at North Coast International Airport. The airport is operating under normal conditions, but a series of simulated contacts will begin shortly. Some are legitimate. Some are social engineering attempts. Your task is to identify and respond appropriately. Remember: being helpful is part of the mission, but being secure is paramount. Proceed with verification.
